page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmgn6e.24xlarge is an x86_64 architecture bare-metal server in the Compute Optimized with GPU family. The system is driven by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running on a KVM hypervisor, delivering 96 dedicated virtual CPU cores. Alongside the processor array, the platform integrates 768 GB of system memory, yielding an allocation of 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. Hardware acceleration is provided by eight NVIDIA V100 graphics processing units, supplying a combined 256 GB of video memory with 32 GiB VRAM per accelerator.

Network connectivity features a baseline throughput of 32 Gbps, while local disk storage is not bundled with the server profile. Operators must configure remote cloud block storage solutions to maintain persistent file systems and boot partitions. With eight integrated accelerators and substantial system memory, the machine delivers high hardware density for parallel processing tasks. Cost efficiency is driven by the consolidation of compute capacity, large aggregate memory, and multi-GPU parallelism within a single bare-metal host, though storage costs must be provisioned externally.

This server type is engineered for heavy machine learning and computational workloads. The combination of 96 cores, 768 GB of host memory, and eight NVIDIA V100 accelerators fits distributed deep learning model training, GPU-based batch inferencing, high-performance computing simulations, molecular dynamics, and large-scale parallel processing.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmgn6e.24xlarge is a high-density, GPU-accelerated bare-metal instance running on a KVM hypervisor. Powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8163 processor, it offers 96 dedicated vCPUs coupled with 768 GB of system RAM, maintaining an 8.0 GB per-vCPU ratio. Its primary compute accelerator array consists of eight NVIDIA V100 GPUs offering an aggregate 256 GB of high-bandwidth VRAM. Network performance is anchored by a 32 Gbps baseline bandwidth specification. The configuration includes no local storage drives, requiring administrators to rely entirely on detached network storage for data persistence. This architectural profile is intended for resource-heavy workloads that need extensive parallel computation, including deep learning training, large model inference, high-performance scientific simulations, and distributed data analysis pipelines.
